annotations.title: Business days between dates, working days calculator: count working days between two dates, skipping weekends and public holidays

description: Count business (working) days between two dates, skipping weekends and public holidays for the US, UK, Sweden, Germany, France, Norway, Denmark or Finland, and list the holidays skipped; or give add=N to get the date N business days after (or before) a date. Other countries count weekends only, and the answer says so. Use for delivery estimates, SLAs, payment terms and payroll dates. Example: from=2026-12-01. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

add.description: Business days to add to from (negative to go back), instead of to

country.description: Holiday calendar: US, GB, SE, DE, FR, NO, DK or FI (default: weekends only)

to.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive; default: the last day of the start month); or use add
